mechanism: Both carbamazepine and St. John's Wort induce CYP3A4 and other cytochrome P450 enzymes, leading to mutual reduction in drug concentrations and potentially subtherapeutic carbamazepine levels.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if St. John's Wort cannot be discontinued, monitor carbamazepine levels closely and adjust dosing accordingly as carbamazepine efficacy may be reduced.
